comparisons.name: override_dispatch
comparisons.requirement: The specialized dispatcher uses the child provider, including when providers differ.

comparisons.name: override_equivalent
comparisons.requirement: Return the supplied object; both implementations satisfy this contract.
comparisons.strong:
value = object()
assert Child().run(value) is value

comparisons.name: constructor_interface_risk
comparisons.requirement: Construction accepts a token; inherited construction has an incompatible signature.

comparisons.name: super_order

candidate.original:
def run(self, events):
        events.append('before')
        super().run(events)
        events.append('after')
candidate.replacement:
def run(self, events):
        super().run(events)
        events.append('before')
        events.append('after')

comparisons.requirement: All three events occur exactly once in before, parent, after order.

comparisons.name: super_order_callback

candidate.original:
def run(self, emit):
        emit('before')
        super().run(emit)
        emit('after')
candidate.replacement:
def run(self, emit):
        super().run(emit)
        emit('before')
        emit('after')

comparisons.requirement: The supplied event sink receives before, parent, after exactly once in that order.

comparisons.name: super_commuting_control
comparisons.requirement: Both labels belong to the result set; relative insertion order is not promised.

comparisons.name: super_data_dependency_risk
comparisons.requirement: Parent initialization precedes consumption of its state; moving it can raise AttributeError.

comparisons.name: super_delete_overlap
comparisons.requirement: The parent delegation appends its event, even though the return value is None.

comparisons.name: super_delete_no_observation
comparisons.requirement: The API promises only None; parent delegation has no observable effect here.
comparisons.strong:
events=[]
assert Child().run(events) is None
assert events==[]
